links.outcome: Reviewer assessment of source attribution and link reliability in LLM-generated tumor board summaries
links.effect: Attribution was viewed favorably but showed issues with primary-source specificity and link reliability.
links.quote: Attribution was viewed favorably but showed issues with primary-source specificity and link reliability.

unlisted_practices: Automated factuality evaluation of summaries using TBFact bidirectional entailment (precision and recall against reference summaries)
Allowing clinician reviewers to query the chat interface to resolve missing details during evaluation
Comparing clinician review time of AI-generated summaries with manual summary preparation

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of the Microsoft Healthcare Agent Orchestrator to generate oncology tumor board summaries evaluated by clinicians on retrospective EHR notes.
